					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1

					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		)

			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )

			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded

	select

		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string

			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency

		lt_base

	select *

			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name

			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em

			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0

		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )

		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base

	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)

SELECT aa.business_date,
                                aa.option_id,
                                aa.option_symbol,
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0 as strike,
                                aa.expiration_date,
                                aa.open_interest,
                                aa.call_put_flag,
                                aa.best_bid,
                                aa.best_ask,
                                aa.vega, 
                                bb.close_price as SpotRef, 
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0/bb.close_price as Mny
                                from market.om_option_price aa
                                join market.om_security_price bb
                        on
                            bb.security_id=aa.security_id and bb.business_date = aa.business_date
                        where
                            aa.security_id = 110015
                            AND aa.business_date >= DATE '2025-06-05'
                            AND aa.business_date <= DATE '2025-06-05'
                            AND date_diff('day', aa.business_date, aa.expiration_date) > 5
                            AND aa.best_bid > 0
                            AND aa.best_ask > 0
                            AND aa.special_settlement_flag <> '1'
                            AND (
                                (aa.best_bid + aa.best_ask) / 2 >= CASE 
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'C' THEN GREATEST(bb.close_price - aa.strike_price / 1000.0, 0)
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'P' THEN GREATEST(aa.strike_price / 1000.0 - bb.close_price, 0)
                                END
                            )
                        ORDER BY 
                            business_date, expiration_date, call_put_flag, strike ASC

    document_type,

SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'

			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select

			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from

			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency

), cmb as (

		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from

	cross join unnest(

			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id

		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'

	from (

			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (

			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'

	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period

		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date

), cmb as (
	select

		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case

					case

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc

				, 'MRP_S'

				, 'INV_SELECT_S'

		union all

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'

		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'

			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */

			  contribution_fytd_lc

			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	from (

	inner join (

			, currency
			, period

			, "level"
			, currency

), cmb as (
	select

		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case

					case

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from

				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'

				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'

			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name

		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value

), cmb as (

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name

				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (

				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'

					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'

				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case

						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )

					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)'

					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly

				, 'MRP_S'

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	from (

	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period

		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date

), cmb as (
	select

		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from

	cross join unnest(

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		, 'Local' as currency
		, case

			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'

			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	from (

		where

	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by

			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency

), cmb as (
	select

		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case

					case

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

		/* VALUE */

			  contribution_fytd_lc

			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	inner join (

			, currency
			, period

		from

			, currency

), cmb as (
	select

		, metric_group_l1

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end

					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
